# Claims

A daily plan lists every command the rover runs in one sol ([[sources/handbook]]).

This paragraph makes a long claim about the rover but cites nothing at all.

- A cited list item that is long enough to count as a claim ([[sources/handbook]]).
- An uncited list item that is long enough to count as a claim.
- Too short to matter.

> [!note] Callouts are exempt
> Even a long sentence inside a callout is not checked for a citation here.

| Table rows are exempt | even when they are long and carry no citation |
|---|---|

```text
Code is exempt too, however long the line inside the code block gets.
## Hidden
```

## Details

See [[#Details]], but not [[#Nowhere]] or [[#Hidden]].
